title_zh: 选择山顶以下的观鸟点

scenario.label_zh: 山顶以下观察台的观鸟安排
scenario.goal_zh: 比较山顶与较低观察台并决定先在观察台观鸟

context_zh: 虚构自然步道旁，朋友 Ellis 与 Noor 看着园区地图选择观鸟地点，不涉及现实天气预报或具体旅行建议。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: The summit is hidden in cloud. Would you still like to go all the way up?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I came to watch birds, not to reach the highest point. Is that lower viewing platform open?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: The sign says it is. I’ve watched birds soar above that platform before.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: It looks like a superb place to sit with the binoculars.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Shall we stop there first and see what we can observe?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Yes. I’d rather spend our time watching than keep climbing.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Then the lower platform it is.
